AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Entrepreneurship.

2. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor

   A. Input Cable Tester

----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Simulated Flying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
